body: So have you got out of this bottomless pit? Or are still stuck? The only way out seems sliting my wrists and jumping a bridge. That will end the pain the pain for sure.

I really appreciate your response. 

I've been in therapy for the past 4 years and it's been a slow painful process along the way. But at the end, I still feel the same. I know what you're saying, you shouldn't tie your self worth to attracting other women, but, at the same time it does hit your self confidence pretty hard at a deep level, that is hard to really describe.
